sources.note: Nothing for Kaiep. Kaiep data (Ross's own informants Leo Waibon and Julie Yaom, Appendix A; Terebu dialect from Laycock n.d., Appendix B) appear only in ch. 4 Schouten sound-correspondence tables (pp. 122-132) and cognate sets. The only 'stress' passages are the Ali/Tumleo Verner's-law alternation (3.115) and Proto Hote-Buang unstressed-vowel loss.
